scope: Kart Royale Windows opt-in observation only

existingInterfaces.timeoutSeconds: Shared step budget; reused unchanged as the action deadline for the explicit new opt-in.
existingInterfaces.windowsHoldUntilExpect: Existing true flag and original single UP/speed>1/position changed validation stay.
existingInterfaces.windowsStartupWait: Existing startup-only600s remains unchanged; not repurposed.
existingInterfaces.deadline_snapshot: Reuse read-only bounded-reader mechanism separately against the active action/release/pause deadline.
existingInterfaces.pause_stability: Currently hardcoded30s; no current per-plan pause-budget option.

validation.windowsReleaseWait: Exact object with only timeoutSeconds; integer1..60, reject bool/NaN/extra keys. Requires windowsHoldUntilExpect is True, exact UP, no menuTap/startup, and existing<=60s original speed+position/progress predicate.
validation.windowsPauseWait: Exact object with only timeoutSeconds; integer>30 and<=60, reject bool/nonfinite/extra keys. Existing explicit nonempty pauseStablePaths stays required.
validation.platforms: Only Windows consumes either new field; default other-game action/release behavior and30s pause stay unchanged.

releaseStateMachine: Begin action deadline at current started+unchanged timeoutSeconds60. Do not extend held input or accept an initial expectation already satisfied.

Require same original game/renderer, documentepoch, owner/session/cancelSeq, active foreground, exact native counter, fresh frame+poll, raw UP and semantic UP. Only the first such sample matching original speed>1 and position changed permits release.
Send the original SDK UP tap/release immediately. Release must complete before the action deadline; a delayed read, missing match or failed release cannot enter a new observation window.

Once successfully released, set one deadline at actual release time+45. Do not reset it on stale snapshots or later samples; never press again. The total upper bound is action60+release45, and every read is bounded by its current phase deadline.

Keep existing baseline plus two subsequent fresh frames with all nine raw/semantic keys released, exact identity/counter/epoch and complete unique same-connection down/release/ACK chain. Natural coasting may reduce speed; the matched held sample remains required and cannot be replaced with coast-only movement.

Keep no-progress and unexpected-pause/error/foreground guards. All exceptions execute original release cleanup. Record actionElapsedSeconds, matchedHeldState, releaseSentAtSeconds, phase, release deadline, per-sample frames/polls and fresh-release count without changing original reports.
pauseObservation: Use explicit45s only for this Windows plan; keep four distinct fresh native timestamps, original minimum0.5s, paused state, all six pauseStablePaths exactly equal and original foreground/background rules.
The independent45s hard budget covers reads and final required polling/foreground check. Do not let a late diagnostic read or the final until() add an unbounded extension.
Stale reads never increment the count. Require actual poll progress in foreground; keep the existing minimized/background distinction.

normal.note: 66.1 is a cadence extrapolation only, not an observed successful frame.

occupiedPause.note: 45s gives bounded margin while preserving all four fresh samples; no original failure is reclassified.

preciseUnitBoundaries: Opt-in sample schedule matching normal original facts: action match29.297, semantic release51.25, fresh58.656 and a synthetic66.1; default fails60 while explicit release45 completes only at66.1. Clearly synthetic final frame, not original evidence.
No held match or semantic consumption by60 fails and releases; cannot enter release phase. Snapshot arriving at/after60 cannot manufacture a successful match.
Match before60 but SDK release completion after60 fails. Release exception, repeated release or re-press cannot produce success.
After successful release, stale/no-progress samples fail at the independent45 deadline. A read returning after that deadline fails even if its data would otherwise pass.

Baseline plus one fresh all-released frame fails; baseline plus two required. Any raw/semantic held key, wrong counter, ID/session/cancelSeq/epoch, foreground loss, runtime error, missing/duplicate/wrong-connection ACK remains rejection.
Natural speed decay after a valid held match is allowed as before; movement seen only after release never replaces held proof. Already-satisfied original expectation remains rejected.
Pause synthetic cadence7.672/15.672/22.86/30.4: old30 fails, explicit45 completes only at fourth distinct fresh snapshot; all six model fields must remain exact.
Pause with only three fresh samples, stale repeated timestamps, late fourth/read or no foreground poll advance fails; each model field mutation/unpause/focus-loss guard remains tested.
Schema invalid boolean/float/nonfinite/out-of-range values, unknown keys, attached-to-menu/startup/multikey/missing-held flag rejected. Existing plan fields and non-opt-in defaults unchanged.
Existing lifecycle/gameplay suites remain on their normal CI entry point; no need for new game physics/model tests.
